about: Shared sample of /ingest formats v: 1 and v: 2. Made by make_cases.py; see docs/DATA-MODEL.md, "Format v: 2".

cases.about: A day of work: a first full send, spend and tasks in the same hour, a send with nothing new, the next hour, waiting on and off, work stopped.
cases.name: steady-day

cases.about: Two computers of the same person, each with its own book, interleaved.
cases.name: two-computers-one-person

cases.about: Spend just before and just after local midnight lands on two days.
cases.name: midnight

cases.about: A send lost on the way: the next one carries the hours of both.
cases.name: lost-send

cases.about: The server lost a computer's row (a restore from an old backup): a v: 2 send of changed hours only is answered needFull and nothing is kept; the full send that follows puts the whole book back.
cases.name: server-lost-the-row

cases.about: Over eight days the plugin drops its oldest hours; v: 2 sends them as empty tables and the server drops them too. A blocks hour set then cleared goes the same way.
cases.name: hours-leave-the-book

cases.about: Dollar amounts a v: 1 plugin adds up in floating point turn into exactly the same usdMicro.
cases.name: money-in-dollars

cases.about: A computer whose clock is 25 minutes ahead: its hours follow its own clock.
cases.name: clock-ahead

cases.about: A second full send within the hour (a new Claude Code session) is merged hour by hour: the book is the same.
cases.name: full-again-soon

cases.about: Two v: 2 sends of one computer arrive in the wrong order (two sessions on one computer): the older one is dropped as stale and the newer book stays. v: 1 has no such guard, so this case is for v: 2 only.
cases.name: out-of-order

cases.about: Through the Go receiver, a send waits with an hour; a newer send of that hour goes straight to the server; a later send through the receiver joins the row waiting with another hour only. The hour of the older send in that row must not write over the straight one (each hour keeps the time of its send, proto 3).
cases.name: receiver-row-around-a-straight-send
